title: Pre-Registered Model Comparison & Empirical Research Protocol

selection_and_stopping_rules.edge_support_criterion: Positive net PnL AND lower 95% confidence bound > 0
selection_and_stopping_rules.fallback_criterion: If CI crosses zero, return INCONCLUSIVE / NO_CANDIDATE (do NOT default to Model A)
selection_and_stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: If Model B features are absent in historical record, report BLOCKED_DATA (do NOT substitute synthetic defaults)
